name: Tyler Hoffman
scenario_title: Morning Gym Trial or Straight Home

output.action: Tyler leaves the gym parking lot and drives home to sleep until noon.
output.explanation: He is running on four hours of sleep, and his established tendency is to cancel physical plans when sleep-deprived, as he did with a morning run last month. The gritty eyes and stiff back reinforce this, so he chooses sleep over the workout.
